summary: Assembly Biosciences filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants. The filing is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. The offering price is tied to the market price of $26.26 per share. Gilead Sciences expressed non-binding interest to purchase pro rata. The offering is a standard equity issuance under an existing shelf registration, with no change of control, restructuring, or other special event. Proceeds will go to the issuer. No deal terms apply.
